subject: general
question: Which of the following is a property of silicon dioxide?

options.text: It is a good conductor of electricity.
It has a high melting point.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It has a high melting point.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] 

Important Points__**

 
• SiO2 is an oxide of silicon.
 
• The chemical name is Silicon Dioxide.
 
• It is also called **Silica, Silicic oxide or silicic acid.**
 
• **Properties of silicon dioxide:**
 
 
• It is not soluble in water.
 
• It is a bad conductor of electricity.
 
• It is hard in nature.
 
• It has a high melting point.
 
• The molecular weight of SiO2 is 60.08 g/mol.
 
• The density of Silicon Dioxide is 2.648 g/cm³.
 
• The melting point of Silicon Dioxide is 1,713 °C.
 
• The boiling point of Silicon Dioxide is 2,950 °C.
 
 
 
• **Hence option 4 is the correct answer. **
